'''Ronny Clifford Woodruff''' (March 12, 1943 – July 25, 2026) was an American biologist and [[Zoology|zoologist]].

== Early life and career ==
Woodruff was born in [[Greenville, Texas]], and was raised in [[Hughes Springs, Texas]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sent-trib.com/2026/09/01/ronny-clifford-woodruff/|title=Ronny Clifford Woodruff|work=Bowling Green Sentinel Tribune|date=September 1, 2026|access-date=September 15, 2026}}</ref> He attended [[East Texas A&M University|East Texas State University]], earning his [[Bachelor of Science|BS degrees]] in [[biology]] and [[English studies|English]] in 1966, and his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in [[zoology]] in 1967. He also attended [[Utah State University]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1972.<ref name="b">{{Cite web|url=https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bgsu.edu%2Fcontent%2Fdam%2FBGSU%2Fcollege-of-arts-and-sciences%2Fbiological-sciences%2Fdocuments%2Fronny-woodruff-cv-2009.doc|title=Curriculum Vitae: Ronny Clifford Woodruff|work=[[Bowling Green State University]]|access-date=September 15, 2026|via=[[Microsoft Word]]}}</ref>

Woodruff served as an [[assistant professor]] in the department of zoology at the [[University of Texas at Austin]] from 1973 to 1974. He then served as a professor in the department of biological sciences at [[Bowling Green State University]] from 1977 to 2021.<ref name="b" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bgsu.edu/arts-and-sciences/biological-sciences/faculty-and-staff/alphabetical-listing/ronny-woodruff.html|title=Ronny Woodruff|work=[[Bowling Green State University]]|access-date=September 15, 2026}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1994, he was named a [[Distinguished professor|distinguished research professor]],<ref name="b" /> and in 2010, he was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=woodruff&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=September 15, 2026}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Woodruff was married to Susan Elizabeth Barker. Their marriage lasted until Woodruff's death in 2026.<ref name="a" />

Woodruff died on July 25, 2026, at the age of 83.<ref name="a" />
